source: Manifold Markets public API (search-markets, market, bets)
caveats: Manifold is play-money; probabilities reflect a small forecasting community, not a market with real stakes.
Only markets whose question matches a relevance regex (extinction/doom/existential/catastrophe/kill/humanity) are kept; sorted by lifetime volume.
Probability history is the last probAfter in each month from the bet log (up to 6000 bets per market); multiple-choice markets have no single probability and keep only the answers list.
Market creation dates are the earliest signal here; Manifold itself only launched in late 2021.

topMarkets.description:
@Mira is developing powerful AI systems which may be powerful enough to cause human extinction, by misuse or by misalignment. 

Will @Mira cause human extinction by 2030? 

The market will resolve as YES if:

@Mira 's actions directly lead to the extinction of humanity by the end of 2030.

The market will resolve as NO if any of:

Human extinction is caused by another entity or circumstance before 2030.

There are any surviving humans by the end of 2030.

Humanity is extinct by 2030, the culprit is unclear, and any remaining intelligences decide not to do a forensic investigation.

topMarkets.question: Will AI kill >20% of the human population before 2030?
At the beginning of 2035, will Eliezer Yudkowsky still believe that AI doom is coming soon with high probability?
topMarkets.description:
If Eliezer believes that there's at least a 75% chance of an AI existential risk coming to pass within the next 50 years, this resolves YES. (Other interpretations of p(doom) don't matter.)

I'll resolve the market based on public statements from them in the previous and subsequent few months. Eliezer doesn't like putting explicit probabilities on this, so I'll attempt to infer their beliefs from their more subjective statements.

Resolves N/A in the event that Eliezer is no longer alive/conscious or AI doom has already occurred.

topMarkets.question: Will Yudkowsky agree that his "death with dignity" post overstated the risk of extinction from AI, by end of 2029?
topMarkets.description:
Resolves YES if he agrees with this publicly. Otherwise, at market close, I'll ask him somehow, and resolve based on the answer. Resolves N/A if he doesn't answer me.

https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/j9Q8bRmwCgXRYAgcJ/miri-announces-new-death-with-dignity-strategy

I will not trade on this market after 2022.

topMarkets.question: Will misaligned AI kill >50% of humanity before 2040?
topMarkets.description:
Resolves Yes if >50% of humanity's population is killed in a 12 month time period and I think it >30% likely that the root cause was misaligned AI. If I am dead then Manifold can resolve based on Lesswrong community sentiment or a poll with a 30% threshold.

See also:

(https://manifold.markets/embed/ahalekelly/will-misaligned-ai-kill-50-of-the-h-53baa02e69ba)

topMarkets.question: Will Destiny debate someone about AI existential risk by the end of 2023?
topMarkets.description: The debate must primarily focus on existential risk, not just briefly touch on it and move on.

topMarkets.question: Will Eliezer Yudkowsky publicly claim to have a P(doom) of less than 50% at any point before 2040?
topMarkets.description:
Phrasing here matters, I will count "P(doom)" in text, and also things like "probability of doom", "P doom", "chance we all die" and other similar-enough things in spoken recorded interviews / podcast appearances /etc. as well as in text. I will exercise personal judgement for borderline cases.

P(doom|something else) is not P(doom).

He must explicitly specify a number that is less than 50 or that his number is less than 50 for this market to resolve YES.

Same as this market, but 50% and 2040
